Table 5: Transition Cost Calibration on stock GCP C3 Sapphire Rapids. Primitives are derived from physical measurements on unmodified silicon (N iterations). Hardware transition primitives (TDCALL, SEAMCALL) are synthesized from established TDX microbenchmarking literature [3], while cryptographic operations are natively measured. These grounded constants construct the analytical projections, fully decoupling emulated control-plane logic from physical execution costs.
